items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had adopted a little boy, who is now – Tracy’s now about 46

ctx.x: Yeah. She was going to leave. We had adopted a little boy, who is now – Tracy’s now about 46 – something like that, because when came back and I found out he was still alive – he’s now – he’s got a job being a x-ray technician.
Right. I talked to him. He lives in Tennessee, right?
